input_ref: explore | Member: Can someone else ask about my medicine?

output.reason: The question asks whether someone else can ask about the member's medicine, which is about authorized representatives or privacy permissions. None of the approved units covers this. U-WEB-FAQ-06 only says who to call about drug prices, U-BEN-COST-001-02 is a cost estimate disclaimer, and U-BEN-COST-001-05 covers HMO specialist referrals.
